title: A Message from London
text:
Hi Anna, thanks for your email! I am happy to hear from you. I am in London this week for work. The weather is cold, but the city is very nice.

On Friday I want to visit my friend Tom. He lives near the park. Can we meet at the cafe next to the station on Saturday? Write back soon. Love, Mark.

questions.text: Where is the writer this week?
Who does the writer want to visit on Friday?
How does the writer feel about London?
What does the writer probably want from Anna?

vocabulary.definition: the job you do to earn money
the conditions outside, such as rain, sun or cold
a place where trains or buses stop

paragraph_translations: Cześć Anno, dzięki za e-mail! Cieszę się, że się odzywasz. Jestem w Londynie w tym tygodniu, bo mam pracę. Pogoda jest zimna, ale miasto jest bardzo ładne.
W piątek chcę odwiedzić mojego przyjaciela Toma. Mieszka blisko parku. Czy możemy spotkać się w kawiarni obok stacji w sobotę? Odpisz szybko. Pozdrawiam, Mark.
